name: CobbleMarket
description:
A player-to-player trading market for Cobblemon (Fabric): buy and sell Pokémon and items, with configurable listing fees, per-player bans, transaction history, expired listing returns, and optional CobbleDollars currency support.
面向 Cobblemon 服务器的玩家交易市场（Fabric）：支持精灵与物品挂单买卖、可配置手续费、封禁、交易历史、过期退回，支持 CobbleDollars 虚拟货币。
